weekly_theme.summary: 水星目前正在逆行（落在天蠍座，10/24–11/13），這段時間適合放慢腳步、重新確認訊息，避免倉促簽約或做重大決定。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，今天對你來說絕對是美好的一天！你在擺脫規則和限制時茁壯成長，經常在自己想像的世界中找到安慰。但您有沒有想過如何在忠於理想的同時也與現實接觸？擁抱平衡夢想與周圍有形世界的可能性。
aries.horoscope_en: Aries, today promises to be a fantastic day for you! You thrive on breaking free from rules and limitations, often finding solace in a world of your own imagination. But have you thought about how you can stay true to your ideals while also engaging with reality? Embrace the possibility of balancing your dreams with the tangible world around you.

taurus.horoscope: 金牛座，是時候放下你缺乏天賦或天賦的信念了。反思你的能力，就像反思你的身體健康一樣。正如您的身體因運動、適當的營養和充足的休息而茁壯成長一樣，您的天賦也需要關注和培養才能茁壯成長。
taurus.horoscope_en: Taurus, it's time to let go of the belief that you lack gifts or talents. Reflect on your abilities as you would your physical health. Just as your body thrives on exercise, proper nutrition, and sufficient rest, your talents also require attention and nurturing to flourish.

gemini.horoscope: 如果你希望有人突然介入並滿足你所有的情感需求，你可能會發現自己無限期地等待！雙子座，對你來說，掌控自己的成就感至關重要。否則可能會導致不符合您獨立精神的依賴循環。記住，這不是雙子座的方式！
gemini.horoscope_en: If you're hoping for someone to swoop in and meet all your emotional needs, you might find yourself waiting indefinitely! It's essential for you, Gemini, to take charge of your own fulfillment. Failing to do so could lead to a cycle of dependency that doesn't suit your independent spirit. Remember, that's not the Gemini way!

cancer.horoscope: 身為巨蟹座，你可能會發現孩子的掙扎與你過去的經歷產生共鳴。他們的教育之旅也可能會觸發你上學時期的懷舊回憶。花點時間反思：你是否執著於過去未解決的問題，這些問題繼續影響著你？現在是面對這個問題、尋求清晰度，最終讓那些揮之不去的問題得到休息的完美時機！
cancer.horoscope_en: As a Cancer, you might find that your children's struggles resonate with your own past experiences. Their educational journey could also trigger nostalgic memories from your own school days. Take a moment to reflect: are you clinging to unresolved issues from your past that continue to affect you? Now is the perfect time to confront this question, seek clarity, and finally lay those lingering concerns to rest!

leo.horoscope: 獅子座，今天是控制財務狀況的一天！如果你被一些熱心的購物者包圍，可能很想加入，但這可能會導致一些財務問題。不過，請記住，您付出的一切努力都值得款待。考慮給自己一份非金錢的禮物，也許是一些放鬆和充電的好時機？
leo.horoscope_en: Leo, today is a day to keep your finances in check! If you're surrounded by some eager shoppers, it might be tempting to join in, but that could lead to some financial trouble. However, remember that you deserve a treat for all your efforts. Consider giving yourself a non-monetary gift—perhaps some quality time to relax and recharge?

virgo.horoscope: 今天，處女座，你可能會在關係中遇到一些輕微的摩擦。與您最親近的人，如您的伴侶或家庭成員，可能正在推動您走向一種不會引起您共鳴的行為方式。你會選擇通過外交維護自己的獨立性，還是會擺脫他們的影響？後者似乎是更可能的路徑。
virgo.horoscope_en: Today, Virgo, you might encounter some slight friction in your relationships. Those nearest to you, like your partner or family members, may be pushing you towards a way of acting that doesn't resonate with you. Will you choose to assert your independence with diplomacy, or will you break away from their influence? The latter option appears to be the more probable path.

libra.horoscope: 今天，天秤座，你可能會感到有點沉重。在克服最近幾天的障礙後，您渴望享受寧靜的時刻。不幸的是，負責人似乎不願意讓你喘口氣。做好準備，不要大張旗鼓地回到辦公桌前。工作似乎無意暫停，等待您急需的休息。何不趁這個機會，為未來設想一個令人興奮的度假勝地？
libra.horoscope_en: Today, Libra, you might feel a bit weighed down. After tackling the hurdles of recent days, you're craving a moment of tranquility. Unfortunately, it seems that those in charge aren't inclined to grant you that respite. Be prepared to find yourself back at your desk without much fanfare. It appears that work has no intention of pausing for your much-needed rest. Why not take this opportunity to dream up an exciting getaway for the future?

scorpio.horoscope: 對你敏感的天性來說，今天可能不是最好的一天，天蠍座。那些最直言不諱、最自信的人似乎會取得勝利。充電的氣氛可能會讓你感到不安、敏感和暴露在平常的環境中。如果可能的話，避開任何混亂可能是一個好主意。
scorpio.horoscope_en: Today may not be the best day for your sensitive nature, Scorpio. It seems that those who are the most vocal and assertive will likely emerge victorious. The charged atmosphere could leave you feeling unsettled, more sensitive, and exposed than usual. It might be a good idea to steer clear of any chaos if possible.

sagittarius.horoscope: 今天，射手座，你可能會遇到一些關於你的浪漫生活的不同觀點。你可能會注意到，你的伴侶比你通常更具冒險精神。利用你感受到的任何挫折來暗示你的關係可以從一點點的振興中受益。這一天有可能為你提供你所需要的東西。
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Today, Sagittarius, you might encounter some differing views regarding your romantic life. You may notice that your partner is more adventurous than you tend to be. Use any frustration you feel as a cue that your relationship could benefit from a little revitalization. The day holds the potential to provide you with exactly what you need.

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，今天可能不是一周中最好的一天。您可能會感受到工作和家庭的限制。渴望認可你的辛勤工作可能會浮出水面，一點點認可肯定會提振你的精神。利用這段時間設定新的個人和職業目標；這些新目標將有助於在您處理持續職責時激勵您。
capricorn.horoscope_en: Today may not stand out as the best day of your week, Capricorn. You might feel the weight of limitations at both work and home. A desire for acknowledgment of your hard work is likely to surface, and a little recognition would certainly lift your spirits. Use this time to set fresh personal and career objectives; these new goals will help motivate you as you tackle your ongoing responsibilities.

aquarius.horoscope: 你可能會發現自己最近有點僵化，水瓶座。你對自由的渴望導致你忽略了一些財務界限。現在，解決任何未決的金錢問題至關重要。在財務責任領域，有寶貴的智慧等著你。採取措施加強您的理解和意識！
aquarius.horoscope_en: You might have found yourself being a tad inflexible recently, Aquarius. Your desire for freedom has led you to overlook some financial boundaries. It's crucial now to address any outstanding money matters. There's valuable wisdom waiting for you in the realm of financial responsibility. Take steps to enhance your understanding and awareness!

pisces.horoscope: 雙魚座，你可能會遇到一個時刻，你必須決定是否要全力投入一段關係。過去的不安全感可能會重新浮出水面，引發不確定性和對失去獨立性的擔憂。消除這些揮之不去的疑慮至關重要！屈服於它們可能會讓你大大倒退。擁抱你的內在力量，並做出適合你的選擇。
pisces.horoscope_en: Pisces, you might encounter a moment where you must decide whether to fully invest in a relationship. Past insecurities could resurface, stirring up uncertainties and fears about losing your independence. It's crucial to dismiss these lingering doubts! Succumbing to them could set you back significantly. Embrace your inner strength and make a choice that feels right for you.
